Exposure to GraphQL. Understanding of microservices architecture. Experience working on enterprise web or mobile applications. Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines. B.Sc. Computer Science / BCA / MCA / M.Sc. IT. Other relevant qualifications with strong hands-on development experience may also be considered. Experience Requirements 1–5 years of professional experience in Full Stack Development or related software development roles. Hands-on experience in frontend development using React.js and JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience in backend development using one or more technologies such as .NET (C#), Python, or Node.js. Knowledge of relational databases and REST API integration. Experience with React Native or mobile application development will be an added advantage. Exposure to cloud deployment and CI/CD processes is preferred. Required Competencies Strong Programming & Debugging Skills Analytical & Problem-Solving Abilities Frontend & Backend Development API Development & Integration Database Management Team Collaboration Communication Skills Time Management Adaptability & Continuous Learning Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for a technically capable and enthusiastic Full Stack Developer with 1–5 years of experience who can contribute to the development and maintenance of web and mobile applications. Interested candidates with relevant Full Stack Development experience are encouraged to apply.

title: DevSecOps Full Stack Security Engineer
description: Job ID 73600 Category Enterprise Technology Location Chennai, India Work Type Hybrid The Full Stack DevSecOps Engineer is responsible for designing, engineering, and delivering security products and platforms from concept through production. The role develops end-to-end solutions spanning front-end applications, back-end services, application programming interfaces (APIs), data pipelines, databases, and cloud infrastructure. The engineer will apply AI and machine learning (AI/ML), where appropriate, to create intelligent automation for security use cases such as vulnerability triage, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and self-service security workflows. The role also embeds secure development practices, Zero Trust principles, and DevSecOps controls throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Working closely with security, product delivery, DevSecOps, and platform engineering teams, this individual will translate security needs and product roadmaps into scalable, reliable, and maintainable engineering solutions. Responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack security products, including user interfaces, APIs, web services, data layers, and cloud-based components. Develop clean, secure, well-tested, maintainable code following secure coding principles and software engineering best practices. Participate in solution architecture, design, and code reviews, ensuring Zero Trust principles and DevSecOps controls are incorporated into product design and implementation. Collaborate with security, DevSecOps, product delivery, and platform engineering teams to translate product roadmaps and security requirements into technical deliverables. Design and implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using technologies such as Tekton, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Build. Integrate security scanning and other security controls into software development and deployment pipelines. Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications to improve performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability. Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality while following organizational security and responsible-use standards. Evaluate and prototype relevant emerging technologies across AI, cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, and cybersecurity. Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, API documentation, deployment guidance, and operational runbooks. Apply Agile development practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Demonstrate curiosity and continuous learning by evaluating new tools, frameworks, engineering practices, and opportunities to apply AI to security and software engineering challenges. Required Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience . Minimum of 4 years of full-stack software engineering experience , preferably developing cloud-native applications, security products, developer platforms, or DevSecOps solutions. Proficiency in modern front-end technologies such as Angular, React, and TypeScript , with hands-on experience in one or more back-end technologies such as Java/Spring Boot or Python . Experience designing and developing APIs, web services, and data-driven applications. Experience with relational or cloud-based data technologies such as PostgreSQL and Google BigQuery . Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps technologies such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Tekton, Google Cloud Build, Docker, Artifactory, and Terraform , or comparable technologies. Experience with a major cloud platform. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Cloud Run, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and BigQuery is preferred; relevant experience with Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) is also applicable. Understanding of secure software development practices, including secure coding, vulnerability management, application security, and integrating security scanning into CI/CD workflows. Familiarity with infrastructure as code (IaC), containerization, and cloud-native application delivery. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to different audiences and collaborate across security, product, and engineering teams. Preferred Experience developing security products, security automation, or self-service security platforms. Experience applying AI/ML, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled APIs to software engineering or cybersecurity use cases. Experience with vulnerability management, vulnerability prioritization, risk scoring, or anomaly detection. Working knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and DevSecOps principles. Experience with Kubernetes or managed Kubernetes platforms such as GKE. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering productivity tools. #LI-MF2

company_description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks, designing REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. Experience designing and building multi-tenant SaaS applications, with a strong understanding of scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, fault tolerance and tenant isolation. Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations across frontend and backend systems. Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex technical problems from ambiguous requirements through design, implementation and production, making pragmatic trade-offs and challenging assumptions where appropriate. Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform, with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB. Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git and modern software delivery practices, including automated testing across frontend, API and backend layers. Experience diagnosing complex production and performance problems across the stack using browser developer tools, profiling, logs, metrics and distributed tracing. Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews, hands-on collaboration and sound engineering judgement. Experience building customer-facing product capabilities, reusable UI components or design systems that support consistent, intuitive user experiences. Experience modernizing customer-facing web applications or large-scale distributed systems and improving engineering practices across teams. Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools and helping engineering teams adopt and scale these practices across coding, testing, debugging, documentation and code review. Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations. Customer-facing web applications and supporting services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable and maintainable while delivering intuitive, high-quality user experiences. Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, design discussions, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance. Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation. Engineers around you make effective use of modern development practices, including AI-assisted development, to improve productivity and quality without compromising engineering discipline. You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgement, full stack technical depth, pragmatic decision-making, and the ability to turn complex problems into high-quality solutions quickly. Provisioning: Build tenant onboarding and offboarding workflows, plan and feature flags, and per-tenant configuration. Authentication: Integrate OIDC/OAuth2 and SAML 2.0 SSO per tenant, SCIM user provisioning, MFA, JWT access tokens with refresh rotation, and session revocation. Authorisation: Implement RBAC with resource-level permissions, API keys with scopes, audit logs for security-relevant actions. Focus B: Billing and Metering Subscription: Integrate a billing provider (e.g. Stripe): plans, trials, upgrades/downgrades with proration, coupons, taxes, invoices, payment failures and dunning. description: DESCRIPTION Like to develop real-time, distributed, large-scale, and modern front-end applications? The Ads Billing platform is an enabler for Amazon Advertising's worldwide rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser-facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and the Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon. The Ads Billing team is looking for a Front-End Engineer to build global, scalable, extensible, and secure front-end applications for Billing, Budgeting, Payments, and Promotions Advertiser Experience (AX). These applications have to seamlessly interact with different downstream ad serving platforms, billing and budgeting systems across a broad variety of advertisement programs with no loss in information, and they build the customer-facing experiences that make billing, budgeting, and payments for advertising frictionless. The platform has to guarantee a latency SLA of milliseconds so that the real-time experience of advertisers is never impacted. Beyond raw performance, these are the surfaces advertisers reach for to understand what they owe, why they owe it, and how to act on it — so the work is as much about clarity, usability, and craft as it is about distributed architecture. To build this platform you will need to be well versed in high-performance and distributed front-end architecture, and care deeply about the experience on the other side of the screen. Key Technical Challenges: Distributed and Scalable Front-End Architecture: Looking at advertising's international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in the near future. Billing and Budgeting front-end systems should scale easily to manage an exponential increase in business and be extensible to support different business needs. High Availability: These are customer-facing Tier-1 front-end applications. Downtime in Advertiser Experience systems can cause a huge loss in revenue and business opportunity for our advertisers, and is a serious trust buster. A high-availability architecture ensures the system is configured to handle different loads and failures with minimal or no downtime. Customer Experience and Usability: Billing is where trust is won or lost. Advertisers need to understand complex charges, budgets, and payment states at a glance, across dozens of locales, currencies, and regulatory regimes. The challenge is to turn that complexity into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software — applying proven UI design patterns, meeting Amazon's accessibility bar, and partnering with Product and UX to ship simple, coherent experiences that advertisers find clear, predictable, and easy to act on. What is Amazon Advertising? Amazon Advertising is a set of tools offered to advertisers — sellers, vendors, authors, publishers, and more — to increase the visibility of their products and services on Amazon, using Cost-per-click (CPC) and Cost-per-impression (CPM) programs. At the scale of Amazon it is extremely important for our advertisers to have the right set of controls to create and boost their advertising presence to gain customers and create long-term value. Key job responsibilities You own what you and your team creates. You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable, performant, secure, and accessibility compliant. You work on feature ideas with customers, designers, product managers, stakeholders, and peers. You increase the speed of implementation of UX features by identifying and mitigating design risks early. You view your interface creations from the customer’s point of view. You start from the advertiser's experience and work backwards — turning complex billing, budgeting, and payment flows into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software, so advertisers can understand what they owe and act on it with confidence. You bring ideas to the table. You spot opportunities to simplify or reimagine an experience, prototype and propose them, and advocate for the approach that best serves our customers in Product and UX debates. You are proficient in view layout and rendering technologies (e.g., responsiveness, device/browser support, progressive enhancement, interaction fluidity) and know when it is appropriate to make graceful fallbacks. You understand how to build, package, deploy, and deliver your code and supporting assets (e.g., images, fonts) to the user. You optimize delivery of code and assets to the client (e.g., using CDNs, caching, compression). You are judicious when introducing dependencies and efficient with resource usage (e.g., application impact on memory and CPU, cache appropriately, respectful of customer’s devices, etc.). The fast growing Ads Billing team today has members across Bangalore, Seattle, and New York, and like the advertising business is truly global in spirit! description: DESCRIPTION Like to develop real-time, distributed, large-scale, and modern front-end applications? Like to craft interfaces that are not just fast and reliable but intuitive, accessible, and a pleasure to use? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that make advertising and its billing frictionless? Familiar with front-end development technologies such as JavaScript, ReactJS, AngularJS, HTML5 and CSS3 and front-end design patterns? Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Customer Experience team? Then, the Software Development team that builds Tier-1 customer-facing front-end Advertising Experiences wants you! Advertising is one of the fastest growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Amazon Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost their product reach and sales through performance and display advertising. The Ads Billing platform is an enabler for Amazon Advertising's worldwide rapid growth and offers a singular platform to manage all of the advertiser-facing functions like billing, invoicing, accounting automation, budgets, promotions, payments, and the Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) in real-time while being transparent and auditable from the ground up. As a part of this high-energy, entrepreneurial team you will get an opportunity to innovate on solutions that control the very levers of our advertisers' experience and have the satisfaction of seeing your work impact multiple advertising businesses and bring in multi-million transactions worth 100x in dollar value on a daily basis. This platform owns these mandates for worldwide advertising displayed On or Off Amazon. The Ads Billing team is looking for a Front-End Engineer to build global, scalable, extensible, and secure front-end applications for Billing, Budgeting, Payments, and Promotions Advertiser Experience (AX). These applications have to seamlessly interact with different downstream ad serving platforms, billing and budgeting systems across a broad variety of advertisement programs with no loss in information, and they build the customer-facing experiences that make billing, budgeting, and payments for advertising frictionless. The platform has to guarantee a latency SLA of milliseconds so that the real-time experience of advertisers is never impacted. Beyond raw performance, these are the surfaces advertisers reach for to understand what they owe, why they owe it, and how to act on it — so the work is as much about clarity, usability, and craft as it is about distributed architecture. To build this platform you will need to be well versed in high-performance and distributed front-end architecture, and care deeply about the experience on the other side of the screen. Key Technical Challenges: Distributed and Scalable Front-End Architecture: Looking at advertising's international expansion and business growth plans for next year, we expect this traffic to grow 10X in the near future. Billing and Budgeting front-end systems should scale easily to manage an exponential increase in business and be extensible to support different business needs. High Availability: These are customer-facing Tier-1 front-end applications. Downtime in Advertiser Experience systems can cause a huge loss in revenue and business opportunity for our advertisers, and is a serious trust buster. A high-availability architecture ensures the system is configured to handle different loads and failures with minimal or no downtime. Customer Experience and Usability: Billing is where trust is won or lost. Advertisers need to understand complex charges, budgets, and payment states at a glance, across dozens of locales, currencies, and regulatory regimes. The challenge is to turn that complexity into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software — applying proven UI design patterns, meeting Amazon's accessibility bar, and partnering with Product and UX to ship simple, coherent experiences that advertisers find clear, predictable, and easy to act on. What is Amazon Advertising? Amazon Advertising is a set of tools offered to advertisers — sellers, vendors, authors, publishers, and more — to increase the visibility of their products and services on Amazon, using Cost-per-click (CPC) and Cost-per-impression (CPM) programs. At the scale of Amazon it is extremely important for our advertisers to have the right set of controls to create and boost their advertising presence to gain customers and create long-term value. Key job responsibilities You own what you and your team creates. You work with your team to invent, design, and build software that is stable, performant, secure, and accessibility compliant. You work on feature ideas with customers, designers, product managers, stakeholders, and peers. You increase the speed of implementation of UX features by identifying and mitigating design risks early. You view your interface creations from the customer’s point of view. You start from the advertiser's experience and work backwards — turning complex billing, budgeting, and payment flows into interfaces that decrease friction between the customer and the software, so advertisers can understand what they owe and act on it with confidence. You bring ideas to the table. You spot opportunities to simplify or reimagine an experience, prototype and propose them, and advocate for the approach that best serves our customers in Product and UX debates. You are proficient in view layout and rendering technologies (e.g., responsiveness, device/browser support, progressive enhancement, interaction fluidity) and know when it is appropriate to make graceful fallbacks. You understand how to build, package, deploy, and deliver your code and supporting assets (e.g., images, fonts) to the user. You optimize delivery of code and assets to the client (e.g., using CDNs, caching, compression). You are judicious when introducing dependencies and efficient with resource usage (e.g., application impact on memory and CPU, cache appropriately, respectful of customer’s devices, etc.). The fast growing Ads Billing team today has members across Bangalore, Seattle, and New York, and like the advertising business is truly global in spirit! BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience 1+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description: Description Job Title: Software Engineer - Java Employment Type: Permanent Work Location: Chennai India - Hybrid About CloudBees CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. About The Role We use Claude Code every day and are pushing agentic AI further into how we work. If you want to be on a team figuring out what AI-assisted engineering actually looks like on a real, complex product (not a sandbox), this is it. CDRO (Continuous Delivery & Release Orchestration) is CloudBees' enterprise CD product. It's been running in production at some of the world's largest engineering orgs for over a decade. Hundreds of engineers depend on it to ship software safely and on schedule. We're a team of about 10, distributed across India, France, Spain, and the US. We're not chasing the next hype cycle feature. We operate a product real customers depend on, modernize it while keeping it stable, and do it with a small team that takes ownership seriously. Key Responsibilities Most teams try AI coding tools on greenfield work. We're doing something harder: applying them to a decade-old enterprise codebase with real customers depending on it. CDRO's core is Java 21 with a significant Groovy layer. The work is a mix of internal cleanup that makes the codebase easier to evolve, and direct improvements that make customers' lives better. Concretely: Own Java work across the core: REST API, pipeline execution engine, persistence layer Continuously reduce complexity: modernize older subsystems, shrink the product surface area where it makes sense, improve test coverage, and leave the codebase easier than you found it Use Claude Code as a normal part of your workflow, to move faster without skipping thought Write tests that prove things work. Shift-left, not "QA will catch it." Document what you build. We're async across timezones. If you know something the team needs to know, write it down. Actively avoid being a single point of failure for anything you own Qualifications Required: Solid Java. You've worked professionally at least 4 years developing Java software, in production codebases that weren't yours, in systems that mattered if they broke. Strong AI awareness: you know what Claude Code, or Cursor, etc. do. You've played with some of them at least. Relational database experience: SQL, JPA/Hibernate, schema migrations. Oracle or PostgreSQL background is a strong advantage. Comfort in large, mature codebases. You can navigate unfamiliar code, form a hypothesis, test it, and stay functional when you don't understand everything at once. Testing discipline. You write unit and integration tests as part of the work, not after. Honest communication. If something is blocked or broken, we need to know. We're async and distributed. Strong plus: Active use of Claude Code to ship real work, not just tab completion. Bonus: you want to push it much further than you do today. Groovy. Willingness to pick it up fast matters more than prior credentials. Kubernetes/Helm: deploying and debugging workloads, not just using them. Experience evolving established systems: migrations, incremental rewrites, dependency upgrades. Preferred (not mandatory): Jenkins or CI/CD internals Distributed systems infrastructure: message brokers (ActiveMQ, Artemis, RabbitMQ), coordination (Zookeeper) React/TypeScript: the UI is adjacent and not your main domain, but not being afraid of it helps Who This Is For You're a Java engineer who finds large, evolved codebases interesting rather than off-putting. You've seen what breaks when systems are poorly documented and owned by one person. You build the opposite. You want hard engineering problems, real ownership, and a team that says what's true. With ~10 people on the team, you'll touch meaningful parts of the system fast. You'd rather evolve a product real enterprises depend on than build a greenfield service nobody's relying on yet. title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description: Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. About the Role Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers , and its main job is to build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them . You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer. Operating principle: Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next. What You'll Own Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events. Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement. Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps. Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention. Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality. Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators). Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play. Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough. Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams. Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering. Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play. Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests. Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives. Coordinate quotes, Order Forms, approvals and procurement with internal stakeholders. Keep renewal forecasts, customer records and risk assessments accurate and current. Work with Account Executives and Revenue Operations to improve gross revenue retention and reduce preventable churn. Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Partnership Work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Revenue Operations to connect data, systems and messaging across the customer journey. Find manual, repetitive tasks and remove them through automation, integrations and tooling. Document playbooks and share best practices so the model scales across teams and segments. Required Qualifications 3+ years required (5+ years preferred) in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Digital/Scaled CS, Solutions Consulting or a similar SaaS role. Experience managing a high-volume B2B SaaS portfolio, ideally in a digital, SMB, mid-market or commercial segment. Hands-on experience building automation in a CRM or CS platform (Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot, Totango or similar), including journeys, triggers and health scoring. Strong analytical skills: comfortable with usage and engagement data, dashboards, funnels and cohort or segment analysis. Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals: Git, CI/CD pipelines, APIs and cloud platforms. Experience with SaaS renewals, retention and commercial discussions, and an understanding of subscription, licensing and billing models. Strong communication, troubleshooting and prioritisation skills in a high-volume environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with digital CS tooling: in-app guidance, email and marketing automation, community platforms and knowledge-base or content systems. Experience using SQL, BI tools, scripting or low-code automation to build and improve workflows. Experience applying AI or LLM-assisted workflows to customer communication, support or insight. Hands-on exposure to Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or GCP; REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and YAML configuration. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or DevSecOps concepts. Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Architects or implementation teams. What Success Looks Like Area Outcomes Scale & efficiency Higher customers-per-manager coverage with stable or improving satisfaction. A growing share of lifecycle touches and renewals handled through automation. Fewer repeat manual tasks. Adoption & experience Faster onboarding and time to value, higher activation and feature adoption, and measurable use of self-service content. Retention & commercial Improved gross revenue retention, lower preventable churn, accurate renewal forecasts and expansion opportunities identified from signals. Risk & health Earlier risk detection through a validated health model, and more recoveries run from standard plays. Technical Routine technical questions resolved through self-service or by you, and less reliance on Engineering for them. Ideal Candidate You think in systems, not accounts. You are as comfortable building a triggered journey and reading a usage cohort as you are leading a renewal conversation or debugging a CI/CD workflow with a developer. description: About Factori Factori is the real-world data layer for enterprise AI. Our real-world intelligence platform connects business decisions and AI systems to aggregated physical-world signals through the Real World Graph. You will build and maintain pages, improve performance, connect forms to the marketing stack and help the team ship conversion improvements quickly. This is a hands-on web development and operations role, working closely with the Growth Lead, PMM Lead and SEO specialist. What you will own Build and maintain responsive WordPress pages, reusable templates and components for retail solutions, campaigns, customer evidence and resources. Translate approved designs and content into accessible pages with consistent navigation, clear calls to action and a usable mobile experience. Own marketing forms, confirmation states, scheduling links and CRM handoffs. Verify successful submissions, source capture, deduplication and recovery when an integration fails. Implement and validate analytics events and tags with growth colleagues. Distinguish successful lead submission from a button click, prevent duplicate events and respect consent settings. Improve page speed, Core Web Vitals and reliability. Diagnose rendering, caching, asset-loading and plugin issues using browser and monitoring tools. Implement SEO requirements, including redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, metadata, internal links and accurate structured data. Support migrations with a tested URL map and post-release checks. Maintain staging, version control, release checks and rollback procedures. Coordinate hosting, DNS, backups, access and security maintenance with engineering or IT owners. Run measured conversion improvements with the Growth Lead using form diagnostics, user feedback and analytics. Use controlled tests when traffic supports them. Implement and monitor A/B tests and other performance experiments to enhance website performance. Required AI knowledge and skills Practical knowledge of using AI in web development, maintenance and quality assurance workflows is required for this role. Proficiency with coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or equivalents for component development, troubleshooting and integration work. Understanding of how to review and validate AI-generated code for functionality, accessibility, responsiveness, security and performance, including protecting credentials and sensitive information. Ability to structure repeatable AI-assisted workflows for page creation, migration checks or site QA. Knowledge of staging, automated checks, human release review and rollback procedures. What you bring 1-4 Years experience maintaining a production marketing website and examples of pages or integrations you personally shipped. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and WordPress themes, templates and plugins. You can debug beyond a page builder; PHP familiarity is useful. Comfort with Git, browser developer tools, APIs, JSON and webhooks, including diagnosing failed form submissions and integration errors. Familiarity with technical SEO, responsive design and accessibility, plus analytics tools such as GA4, Google Tag Manager or PostHog. Practical AI-assisted development experience and the ability to explain, test and maintain the resulting code. You communicate clearly about dependencies and release risk. Experience with custom WordPress blocks, CRM integrations, automated browser checks or website migrations is useful. Deep product-backend engineering is not a prerequisite. What success looks like In your first 90 days, establish a verified website and integration baseline, ship reusable retail and campaign templates, and close the highest-impact defects in priority conversion journeys. We will assess successful form delivery, release quality, page performance, accessibility and publishing turnaround. Conversion improvements are shared with growth, PMM and SEO, and measured on prospect journeys rather than privacy-page traffic. Why join You will own a visible part of Factori's enterprise buying experience. The role combines web craft, marketing systems and practical AI-assisted development, with direct feedback from the people using the pages and the teams receiving the leads.

Job Summary: We seek a Senior UI Developer to join our dynamic UI development team responsible for building and maintaining our global large-scale eCommerce platform. This role requires strong expertise in React/TypeScript, Node.js, and Apollo Client, focusing on delivering responsive, high-performance user interfaces for a seamless customer experience. As a Senior UI Developer, you will work in cross-functional team’s delivering small Agile changes to huge strategic projects. You will be supported by UX Designers, back-end developers, architects and the wider UI developer team to build scalable and visually stunning user interfaces that will power our online storefronts. Responsibilities: Lead the development of user interfaces using React and related libraries to create highly interactive, user-friendly, and visually appealing applications. Work closely with BA’s, Product Owners, UX/UI designers, and back-end engineers to transform business requirements into technical solutions, ensuring a seamless and cohesive e-commerce experience. Focus on optimizing the performance of the UI to ensure fast load times, smooth navigation, and a responsive experience across devices. This includes updating and refactoring our extensive caching solution, which is provided by Akamai at the front door, but also relies on several layers of caching technologies deeper in the application stack. Implement data fetching and state management through Apollo Client and integrate the UI with RESTful and GraphQL APIs built with Node.js and Apollo Server. Be an advocate for and follow best practices for software development, including clean, maintainable code, automated testing, and code reviews. Mentor junior and mid-level developers, offering guidance on React development, front-end architecture, and best practices. Actively engage and freely share your experience in our Front-end Guild group. Our internal community of UI Development professionals, like yourself, who want to provide the best UI outcomes, in the most modern and up to date ways. Works with back-end engineers to integrate front-end with back-end services and help shape the architecture and performance of the entire application stack. Keep up-to-date with the latest developments in front-end technologies, especially within the React ecosystem and eCommerce trends. Required Skills & Qualifications: Proven experience as a Front-End or UI Developer, with hands-on React/TypeScript experience. Ideally, you will have held a senior position previously, or you can demonstrate why you should step up to the Senior level. You will be able to demonstrate your competency in all of these technologies and tools - ReactJS, TypeScript, Node.js, Loadable Components, Jest, Styled Components, Storybook, GraphQL and Apollo (client/server) and Akamai caching (or another CDN). To stress our key needs, we will be looking for - Strong understanding of React and its ecosystem. Experience with Apollo Client and GraphQL queries, mutation handling, and state management. Solid knowledge of Node.js and how to integrate the front-end with back-end services. Expertise in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+). Experience with responsive design Experience with Gitlab and their GitFlow version control process. Ability to collaborate with UX/UI designers and translate Figma and Storybook prototypes into functional, high-quality user interfaces. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, focusing on user-centric solutions. Familiarity with front-end testing frameworks (Jest in particular). We also do A/B testing via Adobe Target. Proficient in optimizing UI performance for large-scale applications, with experience implementing lazy loading, code splitting, and other advanced optimization techniques. Familiarity with the challenges of building and scaling eCommerce platforms is a plus. Previous experience in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Development experience with Headless CMS’s solutions like Bloomreach would be beneficial. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work in partnership and across distributed teams. We rely on frequent show and tells of working software, strong technical leadership qualities, including the ability to mentor junior developers and advocate for best practices in front-end development. Attention to detail with a passion for creating beautiful, functional, and user-centric designs. Ability to manage time and prioritize tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

Instrument agents with logging, tracing, and cost/latency monitoring using tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or OpenTelemetry. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into agent designs and document trade-offs and limitations. title: UI/UX Engineer
description: INSIGHT GLOBAL - INTERNAL OPPORTUNITY: Join the team at IG HQ in Hyderabad! IG LABS · AN INSIGHT GLOBAL COMPANY UI/UX Engineer Designing and Building the Interfaces That Make Agents Usable Location: Hyderabad, India The Role We are looking for a UI/UX Engineer to design and build the interfaces that make IG Labs' agentic systems usable and trusted. An agent only delivers value if people act on it, and that comes down to the surfaces where humans meet the system: the review and approval screens, the agent consoles, the dashboards that make autonomy legible. You both design and build those surfaces in production. This is core delivery engineering, not a finishing touch applied at the end. You take on the hardest product problems in our client work: the human-in-the-loop workflow that has to earn an operator's trust, the dense decision interface that has to feel simple, the dashboard that turns an agent's work into something a stakeholder believes. You own the experience from first sketch to shipped interface, and you are accountable for whether people actually adopt it. Everything you build, you build to last beyond one client. The component libraries, design system, and interaction patterns you create become Factory IP that compounds across every engagement, so each project starts ahead of the last. You are a senior engineer in our delivery organization, based in India, working within the POD model alongside the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the Data and Technical/Field engineers who build the rest of the system. Key Responsibilities Designing & Building the Interface • Design and build the surfaces where humans meet agents: review and approval UIs, agent consoles, and decision dashboards. • Own both sides of the craft: the UX (flows, interaction, and the trust an operator needs to act on an agent's output) and the front-end implementation in production code. • Prototype fast, put it in front of real users, and refine. Treat adoption as a design outcome you are accountable for, not a hope. • Make complex, data-dense workflows feel simple, and make autonomy legible enough that people trust it. • Shape genuinely architectural decisions with the Technical Architect, contributing the patterns that become standard. Front-End Engineering • Build production front-ends with modern tooling (React, TypeScript) that are responsive, accessible, and performant. • Integrate cleanly with agent, data, and API backends, handling real-world states: latency, streaming, partial results, and failure. • Instrument interfaces for adoption signals, so the team can see what users actually do and iterate on evidence. • Hold a high bar for craft: the polish that makes the difference between a tool people tolerate and one they trust. Delivering in Client Engagements • Own your work end to end within live client engagements, from first sketch to a shipped, adopted interface. • Bring the deep design and front-end expertise a client engagement depends on, as a peer to the Technical Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and other engineers in the POD. • Maintain the documentation and handoff discipline that distributed, multi-client delivery requires, so your work is easy to pick up, extend, and reuse. • Be available for the hard, real-time problems that need a working session, not a write-up. Building Reusable Capability • Turn everything you build into reusable capability: component libraries, a design system, and interaction patterns for human-in-the-loop and agent interfaces that make the next engagement faster. • Partner with the Technical Architect to abstract, validate, and document what you build for the IP library. • Actively drive Reuse Index. The interface foundations you create are how the next project starts ahead of where the last one finished. • Treat capability-building as core, not overhead. Every interface you ship should leave the Factory stronger. What This Role Is Not: • Not a designer who hands off mockups. You design and you build, in production code. • Not a front-end developer waiting for specs. You own the experience end to end, from the first sketch to the shipped interface. • Not an internal tools team. You build the systems clients pay for, not internal tooling for its own sake. • Not a Forward Deployed Engineer. The FDE leads the engagement on the ground at the client; you design and build the interfaces the engagement delivers to its users. Different seats, both core. • Not the Technical Architect. The TA sets architecture and standards across engagements; you build the systems within them and shape the patterns that become standards. Qualifications Required Strongly Preferred 8+ years designing and building production web interfaces, with genuine depth in both product and UX design and front-end engineering. A true hybrid, not one side with a hobbyist grasp of the other. Strong with modern front-end (React, TypeScript), design tooling (Figma), and design systems. Experience designing for complex, data-dense, or workflow-heavy applications. Cares deeply about adoption and trust, and can prove impact with real usage. A clear written communicator who collaborates well across a distributed team. Experience designing and building interfaces for AI or agentic products: human-in-the-loop review, agent consoles, and decision support. Strength in accessibility and data visualization. Experience in a consulting, professional services, or client-delivery environment. Familiarity with the access and compliance constraints of regulated clients in financial services or healthcare.

We work across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Product Success and regional business teams to deliver reliable services, improve customer experiences and create measurable business value. About the Role We’re seeking a Business Analyst with a strong focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to bridge product delivery and business validation. You’ll coordinate testing, help business users evaluate new features, manage feedback, and communicate releases in clear, accessible language. The focus is hands-on business acceptance and coordination—not software development or test automation engineering. Responsibilities (What you’ll do) Plan and coordinate business acceptance testing Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts to understand desired outcomes, user journeys, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Turn requirements into practical, risk-based UAT scenarios covering standard journeys, exceptions, and relevant regional variations. Coordinate testing scope and schedules, providing participants with clear instructions, test-event links, and prerequisites. Work with engineering, QA, and configuration teams to ensure environments, test data, and configurations are ready before testing. Perform hands-on business validation and help users investigate and reproduce unexpected results. Manage feedback, defects, and acceptance evidence Maintain a consolidated record of business feedback and communicate test completion, outstanding observations, and potential enhancements. Separate defects from configuration issues, clarification requests, and enhancement ideas, working with product and technical teams to agree next steps. Document reproducible issues, including expected and actual results, supporting evidence, and business impact, and coordinate retesting after fixes. Report progress, coverage, blockers, and residual risks so decision-makers can clearly assess readiness. Coordinate acceptance evidence and follow-up while keeping approval and validation accountability with the relevant Business Units. Support release communication and continuous improvement Prepare business-facing release updates that explain what changed, why it matters, and any relevant limitations or actions. Keep testing guidance, feedback records, and supporting documentation accessible to global stakeholders. Create reusable scenarios and checklists to improve consistency and reduce repeated effort across releases. Apply lessons from UAT and production issues to strengthen future acceptance coverage and identify gaps earlier. Collaborate across regions and time zones, keeping dependencies, decisions, and ownership clear. Requirements (What you’ll bring) Practical experience in UAT, business analysis, functional testing, or a similar role supporting user-facing digital products. Experience translating requirements and business processes into clear acceptance criteria and end-to-end test scenarios. Ability to organize testing with business users, balance competing priorities, and follow issues through to documented outcomes. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to explain business impact as well as technical symptoms. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing user guidance, test summaries, and release updates. Experience with issue-tracking and collaborative documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalents. Understanding of Agile delivery and the differences between engineering QA, business acceptance, and release approval. Experience with test-management tools, basic data queries, or API-testing tools to support investigations. What success looks like Business users know what to test, how to participate, and where to provide feedback. Critical business journeys have clear acceptance coverage and traceable results. Defects and feedback are actionable, assigned, and followed through, with unresolved risks visible before release decisions. Business approvers receive concise evidence to support acceptance decisions. Release communications clearly explain changes and limitations, helping teams prepare for adoption. What You'll Do • Write SQL to pull and combine ad, app and revenue data, using window functions, CTEs and date-based rollups. • Build and maintain dashboards for key metrics such as revenue, eCPM, fill rate, CTR, installs and cost per install. • Analyze trends by country, platform, app and demand partner, and explain why a number moved. • Clean and explore data in Python (pandas and NumPy): handle missing values and duplicates, aggregate data and spot outliers. • Design and analyze A/B tests on ad placements, formats and pricing, and give a clear go/no go recommendation backed by numbers. • Flag unusual traffic or sudden changes in key metrics, and work with Ad Ops to investigate them. • Turn findings into short write-ups and recommendations that non-technical teams can act on. • Improve data quality by defining metrics consistently and documenting where each number comes from. What We're Looking For • Experience: 2–5 years in a data analyst or similar analytics role. • SQL (strong): Joins, GROUP BY, CTEs, window functions (RANK, LAG, running totals) and date logic. You write queries that stay correct when data is missing or duplicated. • Python for analysis: pandas and NumPy for filtering, groupby, pivot tables, handling missing values and exploratory data analysis (EDA). • Statistics: Means vs. medians, distributions and outliers, confidence intervals, p-values and A/B testing fundamentals, including common pitfalls such as multiple testing and skewed data. • Dashboards: Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool, such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase. • Problem solving: You break a vague question into clear steps and sanity-check your answer before sharing it. • Communication: You explain findings in plain language, with one clear chart and one clear recommendation. • Education: A degree in a quantitative field (engineering, statistics, mathematics, economics or computer science), or equivalent experience. title: MRE Intern
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Every good sales conversation at Sprinto starts long before anyone picks up the phone. It starts with knowing who to talk to, what's happening inside their company, and why compliance is suddenly on their roadmap. That's the work you'll be doing. As a Market Research & Enrichment Intern, you'll dig into companies, industries, and markets to figure out which accounts fit Sprinto and which people inside them matter. Your research becomes the foundation our Sales and Marketing teams build campaigns on. This isn't a "copy names into a sheet" internship. You'll learn how modern B2B companies decide who to sell to, and you'll get sharp at finding signal in messy, scattered, publicly available information. If you like puzzles, get satisfaction from a clean and well organised dataset, and enjoy going down research rabbit holes, you'll enjoy this one. Where you'll leave your mark? Run primary and secondary research to build a picture of companies, industries, markets, and customers Find and organise information from public sources into something the team can actually act on Identify relevant companies and contacts against clearly defined research criteria Collect, validate, and structure research data in spreadsheets and internal systems Keep our research databases accurate and current, and flag what's gone stale Analyse what you find and turn it into summaries, reports, and presentations Pull together market, account, and customer insights that feed Sales and Marketing initiatives Learn and apply the research methodologies, tools, and processes the team runs on Work closely with your manager and teammates on ongoing research projects The kind of builder we're looking for - You're a fresher or currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing, or something adjacent You've already done at least 3 months as a Marketing Research Intern, so you know what real research work feels like You're good at finding things. Give you a half-formed question and you'll come back with sources, structure, and a point of view You're comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets and can keep a large dataset clean without being told twice You're detail-obsessed. A mismatched column or a duplicate row bothers you You think logically, write clearly, and can explain what your research means, not just what it says You pick up new tools quickly and don't wait for a manual You're curious enough to research an industry you've never heard of and come out understanding it You like working with data to answer questions, and you're interested in market research, sales, and B2B SaaS You adapt easily, stay open to feedback, and are comfortable in a fast-moving environment Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: IT Intern – Gadget & Tech Support Operations
description: Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. Rig / Productivity Team - Intern Function: Operations – Rig Data Processing & Productivity Work Mode: On-site Shift: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Role Overview The Rig / Productivity Team is responsible for ensuring that recorded field data is uploaded, reconciled, validated, and made ready for reuse. The role combines two critical functions: processing SD card data and reviewing recorded videos to determine whether the data is valid. The team ensures that every uploaded batch is accounted for, SD cards are returned to inventory within the expected turnaround time, and valid-data assessments are completed accurately. No shortcuts in data handling, no unexplained pending work, and no compromise on data quality. What You'll Own Rig: Complete the upload-to-return cycle for SD cards, ensuring data is uploaded successfully before cards are formatted and returned to inventory. Productivity: Review recorded videos and accurately determine valid vs. invalid data. Maintain complete visibility of pending work, turnaround time, and any data-related issues. Ensure that every batch is processed in the correct sequence and that no data is skipped or misrepresented. Key Responsibilities SD Card Data Processing & Upload Receive reconciled SD cards from the inventory team. Upload recorded data to the cloud as per the defined process. Verify that uploads are completed successfully before proceeding to formatting. Track uploaded, pending, and failed uploads. Report any corrupt cards, upload failures, or other data-related issues. SD Card Formatting & Return to Inventory Format SD cards only after successful upload confirmation. Ensure formatted cards are returned to inventory on the same day. Maintain accurate records of cards processed, formatted, and returned. Follow the complete upload → format → return sequence without skipping steps. Video Review & Valid-Data Assessment Review recorded videos to determine whether the data is valid. Identify and record valid vs. invalid data accurately. Track videos checked against pending videos. Maintain valid-data percentages at card and batch level. Escalate unclear or questionable data for further review. Reconciliation, Tracking & Reporting Maintain daily visibility of SD cards and batches across the processing cycle. Track turnaround from reconciled → uploaded → formatted → returned to inventory. Maintain clean and complete Google Sheets trackers. Report pending work, delays, and card/data errors. Ensure all uploaded batches are accounted for and their validation status is recorded. Process Discipline & Quality Follow the defined upload, formatting, and video-review processes consistently. Avoid skipping, rushing, or incorrectly marking data to clear backlogs. Maintain accuracy during repetitive, high-volume video review. Ensure that data handling and reporting remain honest and traceable. Skills & Requirements Mandatory Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with Google Sheets. Comfortable handling SD cards, card readers, and computer-based data transfers. Ability to follow technical processes and checklists accurately. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to perform repetitive video review without compromising quality. Preferred Experience in data processing, video review, quality checking, or operations. Familiarity with SD cards, file transfers, cloud uploads, or basic hardware handling. Experience working with trackers, batch processing, or data validation. Key Traits Process-driven: Follows the correct sequence every time. Detail-oriented: Can distinguish valid and invalid data accurately. Reliable and consistent: Maintains quality during repetitive work. Honest and accountable: Reports actual progress and valid-data results. Organized: Keeps trackers, pending work, and physical cards under control. Performance Metrics 100% of reconciled batches uploaded within the defined SLA. All successfully uploaded SD cards formatted and returned to inventory on the same day. 100% of uploaded batches reviewed for valid data. Accurate valid-data reporting at card and batch level. Timely identification and escalation of corrupt cards, upload failures, and mislabeled data. Complete and accurate tracking of the upload → return cycle. 3 Non-Negotiables No SD card is formatted until its upload is confirmed successful. All formatted SD cards must be returned to inventory on the same day — cards must not be held unnecessarily. Valid-data assessment must be done honestly — no inflating numbers or skipping checks to clear backlog. Reporting & Work Environment On-site at the inventory hub, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Works closely with the Inventory and QC teams to ensure smooth movement of SD cards and accurate data processing. Requires disciplined handling of repetitive, high-volume work with consistent attention to detail. Our Values Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. About Instawork Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started! Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale. Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York and Phoenix, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about. Personnel Privacy Policy

This role is responsible for the end-to-end operational and accounting support for factoring business . This role will own periodically factoring operational tasks, including report running, document sign off, payment clearance, journal entry booking, reconciliation, and month end adjustment. The core objective is to ensure factoring operations run smoothly, accurately, and fully compliant with local legal, regulatory and accounting policy requirements. In addition, this role is expected to proactively identify process gaps, explore optimization opportunities, and drive ongoing process standardization to align with the global factoring framework. Key Responsibilities： End-to-end factoring transaction processing Run weekly dealer receivable reports, conduct transaction reviews, select eligible invoices for purchase, consider factoring limit, and finally generate Offer to Sale and Bill of Sale reports; process docsign; prepare and release payment as defined in the program workflow. Ensure data integrity, consistency and completeness for downstream analysis. Collect dealer payment information and execute accurate fund settlement to Cat Financial following standard process. Estimate upcoming dealer collection at month end, to facilitate appropriate accounting entries for both sides. Raise request to RTR to complete all factoring related journal entry booking, including Offer to Sale entries, discounts entries, and service fee. Ensure all accounting treatments comply with accounting policy, factoring agreement and regulatory requirements. Reconciliation, exception and variance management Prepare periodic reconciliations with Cat Financial, investigate variances, resolve exceptions and track outstanding/open items, actively follow up to drive timely closure. Support RTR to complete month-end adjustment entries and resolve intercompany discrepancy. Periodic reporting and stakeholder coordination Prepare regular operation reports for the factoring program. Coordinate cross-functionally with internal teams and external stakeholders (RBI, Tax authorities etc.) to resolve operational, accounting and compliance issues. Standardization and continuous improvement Drive process optimization and gap remediation, align with global factoring standard What you will have Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. Experience: 3-5 years in Factoring operations , Accounts Receivable management or corporate accounting . Hands-on experience with factoring business is a strong plus. Systems Expertise: Preferred: SAP (CBS/Mach1) Having an expanded knowledge of Caterpillar’s businesses, products, suppliers, customers and policies. Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable fundamentals and the end-to-end Invoice-to-Cash process, including collections, cash application, account reconciliation and exception management. Financial and accounting knowledge to understand and apply the contractual rights, obligations and responsibilities of each party under the factoring agreement. Ability to understand the broader financial impact of factoring transactions, including cash flow, receivables, factoring costs, and period-end financial reporting Core Competencies Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Compliance awareness: Ensure all transactions, accounting treatments and fund flows comply with regulations and company policy, maintain complete audit trails. Cross-team collaboration: Work effectively with Cat Financial, RTR, Treasury and other internal teams to ensure smooth and timely execution of factoring operations and respond to any inquiry from tax authorities or RBI. Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way. Financial Analysis: Knowledge of tools and approaches of financial analysis; ability to read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material. You will research questions about system functionality, data, business rules, field usage, security, and user access, helping the team understand what the system is doing today and why .
