Responsibilities Business Requirements & Analysis Collaborate with business partners to understand their needs, problems, and desired outcomes. Conduct requirements-gathering sessions and translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements. Document business requirements, process flows, use cases, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes. Ask the right questions to ensure requirements are complete, well understood, and aligned to the intended business process. Work with the Director to evaluate requests and determine appropriate solutions and priorities. Translate business requirements into clear documentation for technical and development teams. Help find opportunities to improve existing processes rather than simply replicating inefficient processes in the CRM. Maintain clear documentation of requirements and decisions throughout the development lifecycle. Issue & Enhancement Management Own the day-to-day management of the CRM issue and enhancement log/backlog . Capture, document, categorize, and track CRM issues, requests, enhancements, and defects. Ensure requests contain sufficient information for the CRM/development team to investigate and act upon them. Work with business users to clarify issues and determine expected versus actual system behavior. Research and investigate issues to determine root causes and potential solutions. Maintain accurate status, ownership, priority, dependencies, and next steps for open items. Coordinate with technical/development teams to track issues through resolution. Call out significant issues, risks, or competing priorities to the Director. Provide regular updates on open issues and enhancements to relevant partners. Help identify recurring issues and opportunities for permanent process or system improvements. Testing & Quality Assurance Lead or coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) for CRM enhancements, fixes, integrations, and other system changes. Develop test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and acceptance criteria based on business requirements. Coordinate testing with business users and domain experts. Execute testing and document results, defects, and required changes. Work with development resources to troubleshoot and resolve identified issues. Conduct regression testing when appropriate to ensure changes do not negatively impact existing functionality. Validate that completed enhancements meet the original business requirements before recommending release. Maintain clear documentation of testing results and business sign-off. Help establish and improve the team's overall testing and release-management processes. CRM Research & System Knowledge Become a knowledgeable resource on the CRM's configuration, functionality, data, workflows, and business processes. Research questions about how the system works today , including fields, objects, workflows, automation, calculations, integrations, and dependencies. Investigate how specific fields are being used and by which teams, reports, processes, or applications. Research and document who has access to what within the CRM , including user roles, profiles, permissions, security groups, and other relevant access controls. Investigate questions related to user access, data visibility, record ownership, and security. Help determine whether observed system behavior is working as designed or represents a defect or configuration issue. Partner with the Director to maintain institutional knowledge of the CRM and ensure important findings are documented. Help maintain documentation of key system functionality, business rules, and processes. Data Quality & Cleanup Support ongoing CRM data-quality initiatives and cleanup activities. Identify incomplete, inaccurate, duplicate, or inconsistent CRM data. Research the source and root cause of data-quality issues. Implement or coordinate data cleanup activities in accordance with established governance and controls. Validate data before and after cleanup activities. Help identify patterns in data-quality issues and recommend process or system changes to prevent recurrence. Support development and maintenance of data-quality reports and monitoring processes. Partner with other team members responsible for CRM reporting and data management. Team Support & Operational Excellence Provide day-to-day support to the Director and broader CRM Product & Data Operations team. Support reporting, analysis, documentation, data cleanup, and other operational priorities as needed. Assist with CRM-related projects and special initiatives. Help prepare analysis and materials for business partners and leadership. Document processes and develop training materials or user guidance when needed. Serve as a flexible resource who can shift priorities as business needs change. Look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve recurring operational processes. Contribute to a culture of strong customer service, accountability, and continuous improvement. Stakeholder Partnership Build strong working relationships with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT, and other CRM partners. Serve as a trusted point of contact for business users with CRM questions or issues. Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. Set appropriate expectations with partners regarding timing, dependencies, and resolution of issues. Help facilitate conversations between business users and technical/development resources. Raise issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of the problem through resolution. Qualifications Who You Are: A strong business analyst who enjoys understanding how a business works and how technology can make it work better . Naturally curious and willing to dig into a system to find answers rather than simply accepting that something "can't be done." Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple issues, enhancements, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously. A strong problem solver who can investigate an issue, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly. title: fraud analyst
description: what is CRED? CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. here’s what will be in store for you at CRED once you join as a part of the datascience fraud team: role overview as a fraud analyst at CRED, you’ll work at the intersection of data, technology and fraud prevention to identify and prevent emerging fraud patterns across products. fraud patterns continue to evolve, making it important to identify and address emerging risks and vulnerabilities. you’ll think like an adversary -analyse data and system behaviour, spot unusual patterns and vulnerabilities, and work closely with data science, product and engineering teams to build practical solutions that prevent fraud. this is a hands-on problem-solving role. you don’t need to be a fraud expert or a deep ml specialist. what matters is strong analytical and coding fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to approach problems from first principles. what will you do? fraud detection & analysis: analyse large datasets to identify unusual patterns, behaviours and signals that could indicate emerging fraud. investigate how fraudsters may be exploiting products, processes or system vulnerabilities. develop hypotheses, test them through data and translate findings into practical fraud detection approaches. fraud prevention & problem solving: work with data science and engineering to identify and close gaps in fraud detection and prevention. identify new signals and approaches that can improve our ability to detect evolving fraud patterns. build and iterate on detection logic and solutions as fraud patterns and attack methods change. cross-functional execution: partner with product and engineering teams across cred to understand new product flows and identify potential fraud risks. work closely with engineering to implement signals, controls and other prevention mechanisms. operate across different products and problem statements as fraud is a horizontal problem across CRED. continuous learning: stay curious about how systems work and how they can be exploited. learn continuously as new fraud patterns, technologies and vulnerabilities emerge. bring an adversarial / "hacker" mindset to problem solving , think beyond the obvious solution and challenge existing assumptions. you should apply if you: have 1–2 years of experience in data science, analytics, engineering or a related technical role. have strong sql and analytical skills and are comfortable working with large datasets. have good hands-on python/coding experience. have a basic understanding of data science /ML concepts such as features, models and how models are deployed. you do not need to be an ml specialist or have built fraud models before. are highly curious and willing to learn, especially in ambiguous and unfamiliar problem spaces. have an adversarial / hacker mindset you naturally think about how a system might be broken, exploited or circumvented. are comfortable getting hands-on and working closely with engineering and product to take an idea from analysis to implementation. have strong ownership and grit, and are comfortable operating with urgency when the problem demands it. how is life at CRED? working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. With the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company. hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance. to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word. there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. description: Job Description: Job Title: Regulatory Control Analyst Corporate Title: Associate Location: Bangalore, India Role Description The candidate for the AFC Centre of Excellence for KYC is supporting CB and IB KYC escalations to AFC, collaborating with the relevant Business stakeholders, Client Lifecycle Management and other AFC functions. Primary focus of the reviewer would be to ensure they review and approve the risk factor highlighted by CLM team as part of NCA/EDR/PRs Organization Deutsche Bank (DB) is committed to the highest standards of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions & Embargoes, Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC) and Anti-Fraud & Investigations (AF&I) and wider Financial Crime (collectively referred to as Anti Financial Crime) prevention. The Management and all employees are required to adhere to these standards to prevent DB and our reputation from those who may intend to use our products and services for money laundering, bribery, corruption, fraud and/or Terrorist Financing (TF) purposes. AFC – KYC COE Implement a dedicated ‘Centre(s) of Excellence’ for the AFC element of the KYC file review, allowing customers to be reviewed once in review cycle. Below are some of the key principals . Achieve economies of scale through the creation of one functional team with sophisticated risk managers, under one global leader who is accountable for the AFC KYC file review and sign-off process. Ensure fulfilment of local regulations and regulatory expectations in an efficient, risk focused manner. Ensure sufficient resources to create and effectively maintain a “follow the sun” KYC file review aligned with ACO availability. Seek opportunities to geographically co-locate the CoE with respective 1LoD counterparties (i.e. align with the 1LoD Target Operating Model) to stimulate cooperation and strengthen the relationship What we’ll offer you As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy, Best in class leave policy. Gender neutral parental leaves 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral) Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents Accident and Term life Insurance Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above Your key responsibilities Review and approve client escalations for Remediation, Regular Review, New Product Extensions and Event Driven Reviews within the agreed SLAs Ensure the generated client risk rating is in line with expectations & procedures. Assess the risk factors identified through the due diligence provided by client lifecycle management (CLM) Apply subject matter expertise judgment as to relevance and/or materiality of Escalation triggers; i.e., can the overall assessment be defended Engage with appropriate BLAFC specialist team where further escalation is required e.g., local BLAFC, AFBC, Sanctions, BIU etc.. Proven analytical skills, problem solving ability, and a control mindset paired with meticulous attention to detail. Able to raise sensitive or potentially contentious issues in a constructive manner to reach appropriate solutions. Deadline driven with the ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to handle time-sensitive projects while focusing on the quality of work delivered. Self-motivated and proactive team player who takes ownership of assignments, thrives in a teamwork-oriented environment, and works well under pressure. title: Marketing Operations Analyst
description: Company Description PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture: At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us! Job Description Role Summary The Marketing Operations Analyst acts as a critical bridge between marketing execution, finance, legal, and key partners. This role is responsible for driving operational rigor across marketing campaigns, managing complex procurement lifecycles, handling large-scale invoice and financial reconciliations, and ensuring end-to-end compliance with partner onboarding and third-party risk management (TPRM) standards. Key Responsibilities Marketing Campaign Operations: Create and manage the execution funnel of all marketing campaigns – Creation of Purchase Service Requests (PSRs), Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PRs) working with business, media, marketing & finance teams ensuring compliance with business terms and tax standards. Financial & Invoice Management: Review, validate, and approve high-volume domestic and international vendor invoices, ensuring compliance with business terms and tax standards. Track end-to-end invoice lifecycles (cancellation, inwarding, processing, approvals, and validation) in tracking sheets to clear payment blockers and resolve tax disputes proactively. Vendor Lifecycle & Risk Management: Initiate and oversee vendor onboarding and registration on internal platforms (e.g., Opaper), coordinating offline/online setups to address technical roadblocks. Execute Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) workflows, vendor categorization, non-TPI checks, and vendor offboarding checklists. Legal Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the drafting, review, upload, and execution of crucial legal documents, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Service Agreements, Addendums, and Statements of Work (SOWs). Maintain stringent turnaround times (TAT) by aligning internal approvers, signatories, legal teams, compliance, and external vendors. Process Support & Escalation Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact (SPOC) for internal query resolution, inbox management, and urgent escalations. Guide new internal teams on standard operating procedures, timelines, and cross-functional processes. Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or a related field. Experience: 3-5 years of professional experience in marketing operations, financial reconciliation, vendor management within a fast-paced corporate environment. Technical Skills: Proficiency in spreadsheet management (Excel), enterprise resource planning/procurement tools (e.g., Fusion, Opaper, Stork), and financial tracking systems. Soft Skills: Strong execution rigor, cross-functional collaboration, exceptional stakeholder management, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate ambiguous operational challenges. title: Operations Analyst, Programmatic Ads
description: Company Description About PhonePe Ads PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform, and PhonePe Ads is at the forefront of connecting brands with millions of highly engaged users. We offer highly targeted, data-driven advertising solutions to top advertisers and agencies. As our programmatic footprint expands, we are looking for a dedicated Operations Analyst to drive the execution and success of our programmatic ad campaigns. Job Description Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Operations Analyst with 1-2 years of experience in programmatic campaign management. In this role, you will be the backbone of our programmatic execution, responsible for setting up, monitoring, and optimizing campaigns across various Supply-Side Platforms (SSPs). You will act as the crucial link between internal teams, external advertisers, and tech platforms, ensuring seamless delivery and performance for our clients. Key Responsibilities Campaign Setup & Execution Take ownership of end-to-end programmatic campaign setup, trafficking, and launch across multiple SSP platforms, including Google Ad Manager (GAM), Pubmatic, InMobi, and others. Ensure all campaign configurations (targeting, budget, pacing, creatives, and tracking parameters) align with advertiser expectations and internal yield guidelines. Conduct pre-launch QA to troubleshoot creative and technical issues, ensuring smooth campaign activation. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization Actively monitor daily campaign performance, delivery, and pacing to ensure KPIs and SLA requirements are met consistently. Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively implement optimization strategies to improve yield, fill rates, and advertiser ROI. Troubleshoot delivery anomalies, discrepancies, and platform-related technical errors in real-time. Advertiser & Stakeholder Management Serve as the operational point of contact for external advertisers and agency partners, providing timely updates, performance reports, and actionable insights. Manage internal stakeholder expectations by sharing regular progress reports, addressing delivery concerns, and highlighting revenue opportunities. Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate extensively with internal Ad Sales, Account Management, Product, and Tech teams to streamline campaign execution and address complex integration issues. Work closely with Product and Analytics teams to provide feedback on platform capabilities, internal tools, and feature enhancements based on daily operational insights. Qualifications Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 1 to 2 years of relevant, hands-on experience in programmatic ad operations, campaign management, or yield management. Platform Expertise: Strong working knowledge of setting up and managing campaigns on SSPs (e.g., GAM, Pubmatic, InMobi). Understanding of the broader programmatic ecosystem (DSPs, DMPs, Ad Exchanges) is highly preferred. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-backed optimization decisions. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets is essential. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven track record of managing internal and external stakeholders effectively. Operational Excellence: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Team Player: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally and drive consensus among diverse teams.

title: Alpha Nodus - Applied Data Scientist - Analytics & AI Agents
description: About Alpha Nodus Alpha Nodus builds Gravity, an AI-powered operations platform for outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and radiology practices in the U.S. Gravity's agents handle work that imaging centers still do by hand : reading faxed orders, checking insurance, getting prior authorizations, scheduling patients and chasing payment. Every one of those workflows produces data about how the practice runs and how well our agents perform. The Role You'll be the person who understands that data better than anyone. You'll make our AI agents measurably better, turn operational data into insights our customers act on, and tell engineering exactly what to capture so both are possible. You'll work across product, engineering and customer success, and you'll own the question "how do we know it's working?" What You'll Do Make our agents better (about 50%) : Build and maintain evaluation sets for each agent : real cases with known correct outcomes, refreshed as workflows change. Read agent runs closely, group failures into a clear taxonomy, and size each failure type by frequency and impact. Diagnose root causes : prompt, context and retrieval, tool behavior, upstream data quality or a gap in the workflow itself. Propose and test fixes with engineering, compare agent versions on your eval sets and in production, and report the result in numbers. Track agent health over time : accuracy, automation rate, human-override rate, turnaround time and cost per task. Find insights customers care about (about 30%) : Analyze operational data across customers to answer questions imaging center leaders ask : where authorizations stall, which payers deny most and why, where schedule capacity sits unused, where revenue leaks. Turn analyses into short, decision-ready findings for customer reviews and product decisions. Define the core metrics Gravity reports to customers, with clear definitions everyone uses the same way. Shape the data foundation (about 20%) : Design analytics-ready data models : the right grain, fact and dimension tables, event logs and history tracking. Write precise specs for engineering : which fields, in which tables, at what grain, populated by which events. Define what agents should log (inputs, tool calls, outputs, confidence, human corrections) so every run can be analyzed later. Handle patient data responsibly : de-identify where possible, follow least-privilege access and keep PHI out of places it doesn't belong. What You'll Bring 5-8 years in data science, product analytics or analytics engineering, including time at a startup or on a small team. Expert SQL and strong data modeling : you think in grain, joins and history, and you can explain why a table should be shaped a certain way. Fluent Python for analysis, plus enough statistics to tell a real change from noise. Hands-on work evaluating or improving LLM-based applications : building eval sets, doing error analysis, and testing prompt or context changes. A habit of reading raw examples before trusting a dashboard. Clear writing. You can produce a one-page finding for a customer and a precise schema spec for an engineer. Comfort pushing back with evidence and influencing people you don't manage. Nice To Have U.S. healthcare data experience : HL7 (ORM, ORU, SIU), FHIR, X12 EDI (270/271, 278, 835, 837), payer behavior or revenue cycle. Experience in radiology, imaging, or another operations-heavy healthcare setting. Work with HIPAA-regulated data. Experience with dbt, event tracking design or LLM tracing and observability tools. Presenting findings directly to customers. Why This Role Your work shows up directly in product quality and in what customers see. You'll set how a growing company measures its AI and its value to customers. Small team, real ownership, and a problem space (U.S. imaging operations) where good data changes how patients get care. Analysts will work with customers to develop formalized information security policies, analyze the efficacy of current policies and procedures, evaluate the risks posed by third-party providers, provide security awareness training to clients, and provide insight into cybersecurity regulations. Responsibilities (including, but not limited to): Performing and assisting with cybersecurity due diligence assessments on behalf of clients Performing and assisting with cybersecurity due diligence assessments on internal vendors Assisting with coordinating and collecting evidence for internal compliance initiatives (e.g., SOC 2 audits) Providing insight into updating internal information security documents and policies Assisting with executing security awareness training via KnowBe4 Coordinating and working with clients to develop formalized Written Information Security Programs (WISPs) and AI governance programs Coordinating with other analysts and engineers as part of vCISO advisory services Researching and keeping up to date with financial services, US healthcare, and data privacy requirements including DORA, FCA, CCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, FINRA, DFSA, ADGM, CSSF, and NYDFS. Critical and creative thinking to strategize how to add value to customer engagements and improve processes Effective SOP writing. Ability to remain flexible as processes continuously improve. Required certifications: One of either CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, or CGRC Preferred certifications: OCEG GRCP, CGRC, CRISC, CISSP, SecAI+, AIGP or other AI governance certifications Knowledge of Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) practices is a plus. Experience with GRC platform implementation and operation is a plus.

title: Data Engineer
description: Purpose of the role Build and maintain all data pipelines feeding the Databricks lakehouse, ensuring clean, timely, and governed data flows from every source across the Investment Division’s five portfolio clusters and, in later phases, the Group’s operating divisions. Own the bronze-to-silver-to-gold transformation logic, data quality monitoring, security master management, and the Document Intelligence Engine’s ingestion and classification pipelines. Key responsibilities Build and maintain automated ingestion pipelines: Addepar API (daily positions, transactions, cash), Capital IQ API (prices, fundamentals, consensus), Canoe (alternative fund documents), eVestment/Mercer (manager database), email (Outlook Graph API). Implement the medallion architecture: bronze layer (raw immutable data), silver layer (cleaned, conformed, security master mapped, FX normalised, GICS classified, entity ownership resolved), gold layer (analytics-ready tables optimised for ML and SQL queries). Build and maintain the security master: mapping ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, Bloomberg ticker, and custodian internal identifiers across all sources, handling corporate actions (mergers, ticker changes, share class conversions). Build the data quality monitoring framework: automated checks for completeness, timeliness, and reconciliation, with exception alerts to the operations analyst. Build the Document Intelligence Engine ingestion pipeline: receive documents from email, file drop, and Canoe; route to the classification and extraction models (built by the ML engineer); store structured output in gold layer tables and raw text in the vector store. Build the reverse pipeline: push model outputs (factor scores, anomaly flags, risk metrics) from the lakehouse to Addepar via API as custom position attributes. In later phases, build ingestion pipelines for operating division ERP systems (Nama core banking, UMG DMS, hotel PMS, IFM CMMS, electronics POS). Monitor pipeline health daily: investigate and resolve ingestion failures, data quality alerts, and schema changes from upstream sources. Optimise pipeline performance and cost: right-size compute clusters, implement incremental processing, manage storage lifecycle. Qualifications and experience 5–8 years of data engineering experience, with at least 2 years on Databricks or equivalent Spark-based platforms. Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, and Delta Live Tables. Experience building API integrations and working with financial data feeds (custodian files, market data APIs, fund administrator reports). Understanding of security master management and corporate action processing in financial services. Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure Functions. Familiarity with document processing pipelines (PDF parsing, OCR, text extraction). Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent. Detail-oriented with strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

description: Role Summary AI/ML Developers / Data Scientists own the quality of the models behind the platform’s drone video and image analytics. Key Responsibilities Modelling Detection and segmentation: Train and improve object detection and instance/semantic segmentation models for drone footage (e.g. YOLO family, RT-DETR, Faster/Mask R-CNN, U-Net, SAM-assisted labelling). Aerial-specific challenges: Address small and dense objects, oblique angles, scale variation with altitude, motion blur and lighting using tiling/slicing inference (SAHI), multi-scale training, mosaic and photometric augmentation, and altitude-aware sampling. Tracking: Implement multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) with camera-motion compensation; produce persistent object IDs across frames and flights. Geo-referencing: Work with the Drone Data Architect to convert pixel detections to geographic coordinates using camera pose and terrain data, and quantify positional error. Data and Fine-tuning Dataset curation: Build versioned datasets (DVC or equivalent) with annotation guidelines, labelling QA (inter-annotator agreement), class-balance analysis and leakage-safe splits by site and flight rather than by frame. Active learning: Select high-value samples using uncertainty and embedding diversity; run labelling in CVAT or Label Studio. Per-customer adaptation: Define a repeatable fine-tuning workflow (transfer learning, freezing strategies, LoRA/adapters where applicable) with hard guarantees that one tenant’s data never trains another tenant’s model unless explicitly permitted. Evaluation and Monitoring Benchmarks: Create golden test sets and report mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95, per-class precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, tracking metrics (MOTA, IDF1) and latency/throughput per model version. Release gates: Define regression thresholds that block promotion of a model that underperforms the current production version. Drift: Monitor input drift (image statistics, embeddings, PSI/KS tests) and output drift (class distribution, confidence); set retraining triggers and alerts. Explainability: Provide confidence calibration and failure-mode analysis for product and customers. Optimisation and Handoff Export: Export models to ONNX; support TensorRT optimisation with FP16/INT8 calibration and verify accuracy loss against benchmarks. Collaboration: Hand over model artefacts, pre/post-processing specs and test sets to the Python AI/ML developer; validate MVP-to-SaaS result parity for migrating customers. Required Skills and Experience 5+ years in applied machine learning, including 3+ years in computer vision on video or aerial imagery. Strong PyTorch and OpenCV; experience training detection and segmentation models end to end. Rigorous evaluation methodology: mAP, PR curves, per-class analysis, statistical validation. Dataset curation, annotation tooling and augmentation pipelines. Python engineering practices: testing, packaging, reproducibility, experiment tracking (MLflow or W&B). Working knowledge of ONNX export and GPU training. Preferred / Added Advantage SAHI/tiled inference, SAM or foundation-model-assisted labelling. Multi-object tracking and video analytics. Drift detection tooling (Evidently or similar). TensorRT quantisation; edge deployment (Jetson). Vision-language models for search or auto-labelling. Remote sensing or geospatial ML. Key Deliverables Baseline and improved models with benchmark reports per release. Versioned datasets and labelling guidelines. Fine-tuning pipeline and tenant-isolation rules.
